name: Lake Mennar
summary: At Lake Mennar, blue dragonspawn guard the freshwater amid Azshara’s shattered ruins. The shores stay strangely serene, and blue dragons gather here in numbers rarely seen beyond Northrend.

sections.title: A Sanctuary for the Blue Dragonflight
sections.body: Lake Mennar draws the blue dragonflight into Azshara’s ancient, broken landscape. Few places on Kalimdor hold so many blue dragons; Mazthoril in Winterspring is another. Blue dragonspawn patrol the ridges and approaches, guarding the basin’s waters. Beyond their ring of sentries, the lake remains strangely serene, shielded from the arcane turmoil and roaming beast packs found across the peninsula.

faq.q: Why are there blue dragons at Lake Mennar?
faq.answer: Lake Mennar is one of the blue dragonflight’s few gathering grounds on Kalimdor outside Mazthoril in Winterspring. Dragonspawn patrol the perimeter, guarding the basin and keeping intruders from their brood.

faq.q: Is Lake Mennar dangerous to visit?
faq.answer: Blue dragonkin and whelps patrol the surrounding ridges and approaches. Inside the basin, the water and immediate shoreline are surprisingly peaceful if you pass the guards.

faq.q: How does Lake Mennar connect to other blue dragon roosts?
faq.answer: On Kalimdor, Lake Mennar and Mazthoril in Winterspring are the blue flight’s main known territories. Both are rare outposts far south of the flight’s ancestral home in Northrend.

angles.text: As a mage, you may find the blue dragons guarding Lake Mennar of great interest, for they are stewards of the world’s arcane energies.
